prohibited_data_statement.precise_statement: Prohibited market data was incidentally received for DVN and TTWO. It was not used in an enrollment decision, no numeric value was transcribed into canonical evidence, and both tickers were excluded for this cycle as COMPROMISED_ENROLLMENT_BLINDING.
prohibited_data_statement.DVN: Values were VISUALLY EXPOSED to the operator: the issuer events calendar rendered a quote widget in the same page as the event listing during ordinary retrieval, which has no suppression mechanism. No value was transcribed anywhere.
prohibited_data_statement.TTWO: Populated prohibited content was MECHANICALLY DETECTED in the saved response body by a scanner that reports rule names only. Its values were never presented to the reviewer and were never transcribed anywhere.
prohibited_data_statement.superseded_wording: Any statement that no price or volume data was 'retrieved or inspected' is INACCURATE and is superseded by the precise statement above.

screening_rows_explanation.why: Round 2 established no fiscal period for any ticker, so no candidate identity exists. Without ticker AND fiscal period the canonical screening-log schema cannot be satisfied without inventing a label, which the protocol forbids. The 24 classifications therefore belong in this reconnaissance manifest, not in screening_rows. Appending them to screening_rows would manufacture 24 canonical dispositions the evidence does not support.

adjudication_rule.statement: A standalone navigation or heading phrase such as a stock-information link is not itself prohibited market data. A structural match becomes prohibited only when the same bounded region also contains a recognized market value or metric, an explicit market-data attribution, or a machine-detected populated quote-field structure.

screenshot_ocr_audit.limitation: OCR reduces but does not eliminate image-recognition error. A negative OCR result is evidence of absence only to the accuracy of the recognizer; low-contrast, clipped, canvas-rendered or non-Latin glyphs may be missed.
screenshot_ocr_audit.provenance_limitation: This audit establishes SCREENSHOT-CONTENT status only. It does not recover the missing retrieval provenance for s1_1__CTSH__2 and s1_1__MSFT__4: their timestamps, blocked-domain lists, allowed-host lists and canvas counts remain permanently unavailable.
